name: prestaflow/psflowdemo
description: Minimal PrestaShop module used as the PrestaFlow reference demo.

scripts-descriptions.prestaflow: The PrestaFlow CLI: composer prestaflow -- run ./tests/prestaflow [options].
scripts-descriptions.prestaflow:all: Run every PrestaFlow suite (needs a running shop, see .env.example).
scripts-descriptions.prestaflow:smoke: Run the browser-free smoke suite only.
scripts-descriptions.prestaflow:json:file: Run every suite and write prestaflow/results.json (used by PrestaFlow/github-action).
